name: Jumping-shrimp pancake
summary: A coastal pancake from Xứ Nẫu, now inside Gia Lai on Vietnam Tourism’s post-merger culinary journey. The shrimp are small freshwater prawns from Bình Định, and the batter is crisp. Squid and beef versions are also named.
origin: Vietnam Tourism’s culinary journey, English and Vietnamese, under the name bánh xèo tôm nhảy.
howToEat: The name is the shrimp moving on the hot pan. Eat the crisp pancake. A wrapping herb was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The coastal region the article calls Xứ Nẫu. A street is Check on arrival. An hour is Check on arrival.
Quy Nhơn is the coast for the seafood the same article lists separately: lobster, crab, squid, and shellfish, at Hàm Tử port, Đầm market, and Khu 2 market. Those are not this pancake.
